```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(stringi)

source("../../R/theme_reltur.R")
source("../../R/join_dest_type.R")

for (d in c("output/tables", "output/figures")) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# 0. Configuration

```{r}
#| label: config

config_2h <- list(
  input_corpus = "data/destinations_analytical_final.rds",
  seed = 2026L,
  n_perm = 9999L
)
set.seed(config_2h$seed)
```

# 1. Load Corpus

```{r}
#| label: load

long <- readRDS(config_2h$input_corpus)
setDT(long)

if (!"dest_type_cat" %in% names(long)) long <- join_dest_type(long)

registers_dt <- data.table::fread("../../dictionaries/registers.csv")

cat("Corpus rows:", format(nrow(long), big.mark = ","), "\n")
```

# 2. Per-Article Continuous Register Scores

```{r}
#| label: register-scores

for (i in seq_len(nrow(registers_dt))) {
  pat <- registers_dt$register[i]
  kw  <- registers_dt$keyword_pattern[i]
  col <- paste0("score_", pat)
  long[, (col) := stringi::stri_count_regex(
    stringi::stri_trans_tolower(MENTION_SNIPPET, locale = "hr"), kw
  )]
}

long[, n_words := stringi::stri_count_words(MENTION_SNIPPET)]
long[n_words == 0L, n_words := 1L]
long[, score_religious_norm := score_religious / n_words]
long[, score_tourism_norm   := score_tourism   / n_words]
```

# 3. Aggregate to Destination Level

```{r}
#| label: aggregate

dest_scores <- long[, .(
  religious_mean  = mean(score_religious_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
  tourism_mean    = mean(score_tourism_norm, na.rm = TRUE),
  tourism_share   = mean(dominant_frame %in%
                         c("tourism_only", "religious_tourism_mixed")),
  religious_share = mean(dominant_frame == "religious_only"),
  n = .N
), by = .(destination, dest_type_cat)]

print(dest_scores[order(dest_type_cat, destination)])
fwrite(dest_scores, "output/tables/02h_desttype_scores.csv")
```

# 4. Permutation Test

```{r}
#| label: permutation-test

obs_F <- tryCatch(
  summary(aov(tourism_share ~ dest_type_cat, data = dest_scores))[[1]][1, 4],
  error = function(e) NA_real_
)

set.seed(config_2h$seed)
perm_F <- replicate(config_2h$n_perm, {
  shuffled <- data.table(
    tourism_share = dest_scores$tourism_share,
    dest_type_cat = sample(dest_scores$dest_type_cat)
  )
  tryCatch(
    summary(aov(tourism_share ~ dest_type_cat, data = shuffled))[[1]][1, 4],
    error = function(e) NA_real_
  )
})

perm_p <- mean(perm_F >= obs_F, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Permutation test (N =", config_2h$n_perm, "):\n")
cat("  Observed F =", round(obs_F, 3), "\n")
cat("  Permutation p =", round(perm_p, 3), "\n")

fwrite(
  data.table(F_obs = obs_F, perm_p = perm_p, n_perm = config_2h$n_perm),
  "output/tables/02h_permutation_test.csv"
)
```

# 5. Scatter Plot

```{r}
#| label: scatter-plot

p_types <- ggplot(dest_scores,
  aes(x = religious_share * 100, y = tourism_share * 100,
      label = destination, colour = dest_type_cat)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Udio religijskog okvira (%)",
       y = "Udio turističkog okvira (%)",
       colour = "Tip destinacije",
       title = "Pozicioniranje destinacija po dominantnom okviru") +
  theme_reltur()

ggsave("output/figures/02h_desttype_scatter.png", p_types,
       width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
p_types
```

# 6. Decision Gate

```{r}
#| label: decision-gate

cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
cat("DECISION GATE 2h\n")
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n\n")

checks <- list(
  dest_scores_saved      = file.exists("output/tables/02h_desttype_scores.csv"),
  permutation_test_saved = file.exists("output/tables/02h_permutation_test.csv"),
  scatter_saved          = file.exists("output/figures/02h_desttype_scatter.png"),
  n_destinations         = nrow(dest_scores) == 10L
)

for (nm in names(checks)) {
  cat(nm, ":", ifelse(checks[[nm]], "PASS", "FAIL"), "\n")
}
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
```
